q: One side of a rectangular toilet and bath is exactly 1.00 m. How long must the other side be to meet the Building Code's minimum area?
n: Minimum toilet area is 1.20 m², so 1.20 ÷ 1.00 = 1.20 m.
scenario:
PROJECT 1 – TWO-STOREY DUPLEX

Problem: A newlywed couple who set up a real estate development corporation will build a 2-storey duplex in a low-density subdivision in Davao City, aimed at working couples in junior executive positions. You, a recent board topnotcher, will design and manage construction.

Requirements:
• Each unit: a paved 2-car carport (3.0 × 5.0 m per car) in the front yard and a 2.0 × 3.0 m covered porch; both units have the same floor area.
• Ground floor: foyer (2.0 m deep × 3.0 m wide), stairs, T&B and maid's room, all against the common wall; kitchen across from the maid's room; living and dining opposite the common wall; 100 mm slab on grade.
• Second floor: stairwell, master bedroom with walk-in closet and T&B, balcony, Bedroom 1 with walk-in closet and T&B; uses the maximum allowable GFA; 100 mm slab.
• Entrance steps or walkway as wide as the porch.

Site: Lot bounded S (1-2) by Lot 2, E (2-3) by the RROW, N (3-4) by Lot 3, W (4-1) by Lot 4. Sides 1-2 and 3-4 are 15.0 m; sides 2-3 and 4-1 are 16.0 m. The lot slopes up toward line 2-3 at 1:16.

Objectives: The OBO approved more than 60% paved front yard. Each unit should make the most of the lot and keep both carports, since buyers are working couples with their own cars.

q: The second-floor rooms will be air-conditioned. What minimum finished ceiling height applies there?
n: Rooms with artificial ventilation need at least 2.40 m.
scenario:
PROJECT 2 – TWO-STOREY SINGLE ATTACHED

Problem: A Pasig-based developer is offering its third subdivision, zoned R-2 in Antipolo City, to overseas workers. It commissions an RLA to design a 2-storey, 2-bedroom single attached house: concept design, details and contract documents, and advice on selecting the contractor.

Developer's requirements:
• A 15 m² paved carport with a 3.0 m opening at the sidewalk, starting from the lot's right corner.
• Ground floor (living, dining, kitchen, stair, T&B) uses the maximum allowable construction area; storage under the stair where possible.
• Second floor, within the maximum allowable building footprint: Bedroom 1 (13.75 m²), Bedroom 2 (7.75 m²), stairwell and hallway.
• Ground floor is naturally ventilated (no air-conditioning); second-floor rooms are air-conditioned.
• Ground floor line raised 450 mm above the sidewalk.
• Carport floor at the highest natural grade taken from the rear, plus a 100 mm slab.

Site: A regular, rectangular inside lot of 75 m² with a 7.50 m frontage. The right corner is at 0.0 (sidewalk level); the lot slopes up toward the rear at 1.75% and toward the left corner at 1.5%. Bounded on the south by the sidewalk and road right-of-way.

Objective: A fair return for the developer and a functional, attractive house for a starting family of three.
